text:
Jordan: Anyone up for a sunrise paddle + coffee run Saturday? Thinking 7am, meet at Pier 7.
Sasha: Ooo depends on weather ☔
Jordan: Forecast looks clear this weekend :sunrise_over_mountains: ... low chance of fog
Priya: I'm in but 7's tight for me—8:30 ok?
Jordan: Can we compromise on 7:30?
Leo: Count me in, bringing a spare life vest :life_jacket:
Sasha: If I come I'll need a kayak rental recs? Prefer single.
Priya: @Leo can you bring the extra vest we talked about?
Leo: Yup I have one extra, first come first served.
ops-bot: Reminder — city parking at Pier 7 closes at 8:00am on weekends. See <https://city.parks/pier7-parking|parking rules>.
Jordan: Good call. Plan: carpool from office at 6:15? @Sasha you okay with pickup by the cafe?
Sasha: Yeah I can do pickup at the cafe. :+1:
Priya: I'll bring pastries (croissants) and coffee thermos :croissant: :coffee:
Jordan: Awesome. Anyone want to invite a +1?
Sasha: Bringing my partner.
Leo: Solo this time.
Priya: I can take one guest if they can carry a cooler :grin:
Jordan: Sweet. I'll DM logistics and kayak rental options. See you Saturday! :smile:
